summary: Enable sha2's runtime-detected hardware SHA instructions on aarch64 targets. Manifest-policy regression coverage guards target-specific feature selection, and standard SHA-256/SHA-512 vectors guard digest compatibility. Stored and exchanged digest bytes remain unchanged.

replay.detail: No replay, backfill or retained claim change.

schema.detail: No schema, projection or digest format change.

rules.detail: No claim, membership or reconciliation rule change.

compatibility.detail: SHA-256 bytes are identical. Runtime CPU feature detection retains the software fallback; non-aarch64 feature selection is unchanged.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no coordinated interruption.

manual.detail: No manual steps or feature activation.

recovery.detail: Revert the dependency feature to restore the software backend; no stored state conversion.
